title: Small Talk
subtitle: Keep the conversation flowing
description: Small talk is the glue of social life in English. These natural, everyday phrases will help you start conversations, keep them going, and leave people with a good impression of you.
tip: Always follow a question with a short personal comment — 'How was your weekend? Mine was pretty quiet, actually.' This keeps the conversation balanced and natural.
phrases: Can you believe this weather? It was sunny just yesterday.
Did you catch the game last night? What a match that was!
How long have you been in town? I don't think I've seen you around before.
So, what are you up to this weekend?
I just got back from a trip to Portugal — it was absolutely amazing.
I know, right? It feels like the summer just flew by.
We should grab a coffee sometime and catch up properly.
Have you tried that new restaurant on the high street yet?
